desc:
🖍️ Join our group and claim a in-game speed reward!

✏️ Welcome to +1 Speed Pencil Escape! 📚

💨 Keep moving to build up your Speed
🏃 Dash, leap, and climb through a giant world packed with pencils and school supplies
🔥 Power up your character and discover huge speed boosts
🏁 Challenge your friends and leave other players behind
👑 Climb your way to the top and become the quickest player in the server
⚠️ Watch every jump carefully — one tiny mistake could send you all the way back! 😵‍💫

🎵 Satisfying ASMR experience
Enjoy crisp pencil sounds, smooth parkour, colorful school-themed visuals, and relaxing effects while you race toward the finish! 🌟

✏️ Ready, set… ESCAPE! 🏃‍♂️💨
